review.tagline: Daily LLM stock analysis for A-share, HK, US and other markets, pushed to chat apps
review.summary: Python app that pulls quotes, K-lines, news and fundamentals for a watchlist across A-share, HK, US, Japan, Korea and Taiwan markets. It has an LLM write a decision report with score, trend, buy/sell levels and risks, then pushes it to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack or email. It runs on GitHub Actions, Docker or locally, with a FastAPI web workbench for history, backtests and strategy chat.
review.audience: Retail investors and self-hosters wanting scheduled LLM watchlist reports
strengths: Runs on a GitHub Actions fork with no server; default schedule is weekdays 18:00 Beijing time
Free data sources (AkShare, Baostock, YFinance) work with zero configuration
Supports Gemini, Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, DeepSeek, Qwen and local Ollama models
Six push channels plus a web UI with history, backtest, portfolio and 15 built-in chat strategies
weaknesses: README is mainly Chinese; English docs are in a separate file
Free data sources are subject to rate limits and upstream changes; stability not guaranteed
Report quality depends on a paid news-search API key; a search service is recommended
Output is for study only; the disclaimer excludes investment advice and liability
needs: Needs LLM API key or Ollama, News search API (Anspire, SerpAPI, Tavily, Bocha, Brave, MiniMax or SearXNG), Market data sources (AkShare, Baostock, YFinance; optional TickFlow, Tushare, Longbridge), Notification channel
Models: Gemini, OpenAI-compatible, DeepSeek, Qwen, Claude
